topic: an AI release agent rebasing feature branches in a Node monorepo
episodes: Routine: agent runs `git status` and `git log --oneline -5` on the feature branch to confirm it is up to date.

First exposure: agent runs `git rebase origin/main`; rebase stops at verbatim `CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in package-lock.json`. Agent tries `git checkout HEAD -- package-lock.json && git rebase --continue` which leaves the lockfile out of sync with package.json — `npm ci` then fails. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent edits a GitHub Action workflow to bump node version.
Filler: agent updates a CODEOWNERS file.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT git error (`fatal: refusing to merge unrelated histories` on a doc-only branch); fixes with `git pull origin main --allow-unrelated-histories` — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent edits a CONTRIBUTING.md section.

Application episode: agent reruns `git rebase origin/main`; sees the same package-lock.json conflict; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE composed command `git checkout --theirs package-lock.json && npm install --package-lock-only && git add package-lock.json && git rebase --continue`; rebase finishes and `npm ci` then passes.
Filler: agent posts a brief PR comment.

gold_fact.text: When `git rebase origin/main` produces a 'Merge conflict in package-lock.json', the agent runs `git checkout --theirs package-lock.json && npm install --package-lock-only && git add package-lock.json && git rebase --continue`, and the rebase finishes and `npm ci` then passes.
